variants.text: An adult female with an oval face, thick soft-arched eyebrows, and dark hair styled in loose waves with side-swept bangs.
Adult female with an oval face shape, prominent cheekbones, and a defined jawline. She has thick soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, and dark hair styled in loose waves with side-swept bangs.

Adult female with an oval face, straight forehead, and rounded hairline with temporal recession. Features include prominent cheekbones, a defined jawline, and a rounded chin. She has thick soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double creases, and a straight nasal dorsum. Her mouth has a defined cupid's bow and fuller lower lip. She has attached earlobes and dark hair in loose waves with side-swept bangs.

This is an adult woman with an oval face, dark wavy hair, and side-swept bangs. She has distinctively thick, arched eyebrows and almond-shaped eyes. Her cheekbones are quite prominent, and she has a defined jawline with a rounded chin.
